title: The error-report scrub compiles a 51k-character pattern on first use (about a third of a second), on the browser's main thread
evidence: widget-src/src/lib/sentry.ts initSentry runs scrubText('x') at idle (requestIdleCallback, or a 3 s timer), so the first report does not pay the compile. No pattern changed. Measured in Node 22 on 2026-11-26: first scrubText 304 to 332 ms, later calls under 1 ms; after the warm-up the first real call took 0.0 ms. Rebuilding the pattern from smaller parts was not done: its equality could not be proved. Test: widget-src/src/lib/sentry-warm-scrub.test.ts (US-09 AC57).
